segments.title: May
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! May is Home for the Holidays. Students are back, mums are celebrated, and the studio has afternoons that are suspiciously quiet. This month we fill those quiet hours, and keep April's party guests from turning into ghosts.

segments.title: ₹28.9L
segments.text: So, the number. Our May target for Kemps Corner is 28.9 lakh rupees. That's 19 per cent above last May. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 15.9 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 6.94 lakh, comebacks 3.47 lakh, and everything else 2.6 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 62 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 451 leads, 230 trials, and 62 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 13.8 lakh rupees, which is 48 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Mom Said Get Off the Couch
segments.text: First up, Mom Said Get Off the Couch. Students get eight classes at twenty per cent off, in the off-peak hours when the studio is practically theirs. Mum will be thrilled. The plan is 18 buyers at about 10,500, so 1.89 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Mom-entum
segments.text: Next, for Mother's Day, Mom-entum. Mother and child duos get a duo private and a gift for mum, and newcomers get fifteen per cent off their first month. She carried you for nine months. You can carry her to class. The plan is 10 buyers at about 17,200, so 1.72 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Group Project (Finally, Everyone Pulls Their Weight)
segments.text: Then, Group Project, where finally, everyone pulls their weight. Squads of four students buying together each get twenty-five per cent off, off-peak only. Free-loaders still have to do the planks. The plan is 12 buyers at about 9,800, so 1.18 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Don't Ghost Us After the Party
segments.text: And finally, for April's new friends, Don't Ghost Us After the Party. Show up eight times this month, and your next renewal costs less, plus a private on us. Great party. Now the real test. The plan is 30 buyers at about 30,000, so 9 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: ≈20% effective on 3M, ≈20% on 1M with the private

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, student offers go live in the quiet afternoon hours. Week two, Mother's Day duos, gifts wrapped, tissues on standby. Week three, every April joiner is tracked towards eight classes. Week four, squads of four close their group buys.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's May at Kemps Corner. 28.9 lakh rupees, four offers, and 62 buyers to welcome. Quiet hours, filled. Party guests, kept. That's a good May.
